text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Mr. C.B. is moving up! Mr. C.B. is making 
her move!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: So you've come, C.B....!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh, gah!? —What incredible pressure! My 
legs feel like they're grinding to a 
halt...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Still――!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (My—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Everything up until now——!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I believe!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Give it everything! Every, every, last 
bit of it!!! Let out everything I've 
worked for up until now!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—In the lead is Mr. C.B.!! Across the 
finish line!!
(WOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay! CB is the Derby Umamusume! CB is 
the strongest of the generation!! 
Wooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, that was the ab-so-lute 
best...!! Mr. C.B. really is the 
strongest!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh…… S-cchi was so close……!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But this was a great race too...! 
Ace-chan has more than proved how strong 
she is...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...!! I gave it everything I had... 
and I still lost...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Daaammiiiit...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...It hurts to say, but you beat me fair 
and square. That was one incredible run.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. ...Today's race really got me 
fired up too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the last one, the Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I'll definitely be getting my 
revenge!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Nice. ——I'm getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...How can you keep talking to Mr. C.B. 
like that...? I... could never.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ......Ace-san. Why are you so—

When I went out to welcome Katsuragi Ace 
after the fierce battle—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry, Trainer. Even after you 
cheered me on so much, I—”
choice_data_list:
...When we lose is when we must hold our 
heads high.

text_block_list.text:
I saw up close how Katsuragi Ace fought 
with every ounce of her strength. Could 
such powerful running really be all lost 
in defeat?

—That's not true. Not in the slightest. If 
it's Katsuragi Ace, she will surely take 
today's defeat and grow even stronger...!!
choice_data_list: If it's you, you can move "forward"...!
If it's you, you can move "forward"...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...You really do believe in me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Ace's Friend
text_block_list.text: —Ace-cchi—!! —Ace-cha—n!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You two...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Great job, Es-cchi! That was so close...! 
Still, you looked super cool! I totally 
fell in love with your running!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race...!! No matter 
what anyone says, Ace-chan is one of the 
top runners of this generation!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(These two... believe in me too. In that 
case, I will——)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for coming to watch! I'm gonna 
give the Kikuka Sho everything I've got, 
too!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's why— look forward to it!!

"...And so, the Japanese Derby drew to a 
close with Mr. C.B.'s victory—"

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“—A magnificent victory seized by Mr. 
C.B.! Living up to everyone's high 
expectations, but what will happen next at 
the Kikuka Sho?”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"At long distances, it will undoubtedly be 
a battle between Mr. C.B. and Shiina 
Frejus. Amidst all this, Mr. C.B. is--"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"She gave the impression of running 
stronger and stronger through the Satsuki 
Sho and the Derby. And in the Kikuka Sho, 
she showed an unorthodox run—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(......The Kikuka Sho's distance makes it 
a brutally tough race for me. Like I care, 
though...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd chicken out over distance at this 
point...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right! 10 more reps!!

After giving Katsuragi Ace instructions 
for independent training, I was rushing 
around the academy handling paperwork and 
research when—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—So, you're really giving up on aiming for 
the Kikuka Sho, then?

Hearing a conversation carried with tense 
undertones from just ahead, I 
instinctively stop in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm already... at my limit...

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Competing against CB-san... and being 
compared to CB-san...!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I can't take it anymore...! I'm so sorry, 
Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. There's no need to 
apologize. Let's figure out what to do 
next together.

"...To avoid eavesdropping any further, I 
silently turned on my heel. And what 
welled up inside my heart was—"

"The final battle of the Triple Crown, the 
'Kikuka Sho.' Before and after it, my 
desire was to stay by Katsuragi Ace's side 
and continue supporting her heart."
